catalogue: Australian capstone SketchUp drawing object families

ncc_references.relationship: This catalogue captures broad physical building object families for SketchUp drawing tools. It is not a compliance rule set.

objects.name: lift system
objects.definition: A vertical transport assembly made from a lift well or shaft, car, doors, guide equipment, drive equipment, controls and safety clearances.
functions: Move people or goods between levels
Coordinate a shaft, pit, headroom and landings

cad.pattern: Shaft volume with car and landing door components
cad.placement: Between served floor levels
cad.opening: Landing doors at each served level

notes: Use for coordination drawings only. Supplier lift drawings govern exact dimensions and clearances.

objects.name: lift shaft or well
objects.definition: The vertical enclosure or void that contains the lift car, guide equipment, pit and headroom zones.

cad.pattern: Vertical rectangular or custom shaft volume
cad.placement: Aligned through floors

objects.name: lift car
objects.definition: The moving passenger or goods compartment within a lift system.
functions: Coordinate door openings and internal size
Show car finishes at concept level

cad.pattern: Movable box inside shaft
cad.placement: Inside lift shaft
cad.opening: Car doors align to landing doors

objects.name: lift landing door
objects.definition: The door assembly at a floor landing that closes the lift shaft opening.
functions: Align to the lift car door

cad.pattern: Door set at each lift landing
cad.placement: In lift shaft wall at floor level

objects.name: lift guide rail
objects.definition: A vertical rail that guides movement of the lift car or counterweight inside the lift well.

cad.pattern: Continuous vertical rails in shaft
cad.placement: Inside lift shaft beside car travel

objects.name: platform lift
objects.definition: A compact lifting platform used where a lift-like accessible connection is required over a limited height or in a constrained location.

cad.pattern: Platform, enclosure and landing gates
cad.placement: At accessible level changes

notes: Exact geometry depends heavily on the selected product.

objects.name: escalator assembly
objects.definition: A moving stair system including truss, moving steps, handrails, balustrades and landing plates.

cad.pattern: Inclined equipment volume with step band and handrails
cad.placement: Between two public floor levels

objects.name: escalator step
objects.definition: A moving tread component within an escalator step band.

cad.pattern: Repeated steps along escalator incline
cad.placement: Within escalator truss

objects.name: fire sprinkler system
objects.definition: A fixed fire suppression system made from sprinkler heads, pipework, valves, supports and control equipment.
functions: Represent a specialist fire service at model level

cad.pattern: Pipes with repeated sprinkler heads
cad.placement: Ceilings, soffits or exposed service zones

notes: Hydraulic design and coverage rules are outside the drawing ontology.

objects.name: fire sprinkler head
objects.definition: A discharge device fitted to sprinkler pipework.
functions: Show pendant, upright, sidewall or concealed head type

cad.pattern: Repeated point fixtures on branch pipes
cad.placement: On sprinkler pipe at ceiling or wall

objects.name: fire hydrant system
objects.definition: A fixed firefighting water system with hydrant pipework, landing valves, booster connections and associated equipment.
functions: Represent major fixed firefighting water hardware

cad.pattern: Riser and branch pipe network with landing valves
cad.placement: Fire stairs, corridors, service risers and external booster area
cad.opening: Cabinet or wall openings where enclosed

objects.name: fire hydrant booster
objects.definition: An external connection assembly used by fire services to boost a hydrant or sprinkler water system.
functions: Connect external hardstand to fire water system

cad.pattern: External valve and coupling cabinet or assembly
cad.placement: Outside building in fire brigade access area

objects.name: fire hose reel
objects.definition: A wall-mounted or cabinet-mounted reel and hose used for first-attack firefighting.

cad.pattern: Round reel or cabinet on wall
cad.placement: Corridors, exits or service areas

objects.name: fire extinguisher
objects.definition: A portable firefighting cylinder mounted on a wall bracket, stand or cabinet.

cad.pattern: Cylinder on bracket or inside cabinet
cad.placement: Near exits, hazard areas or fire points

objects.name: fire indicator panel
objects.definition: A fire alarm control and display panel mounted in a cabinet or enclosure.

cad.pattern: Wall-mounted control cabinet
cad.placement: Fire control point or entry area

objects.name: smoke control fan
objects.definition: A fan used as part of a smoke exhaust, smoke spill, pressurisation or smoke-control system.
functions: Separate life-safety fan objects from ordinary ventilation fans

cad.pattern: Mechanical fan box connected to ducts
cad.placement: Plant room, roof, shaft or smoke-control zone

objects.name: fire smoke damper
objects.definition: A damper installed in ductwork or a wall/floor penetration to control fire and smoke spread.
functions: Link duct penetrations to fire/smoke separation

cad.pattern: Inserted block across a duct or penetration
cad.placement: At fire/smoke compartment boundaries or duct branches

objects.name: gas service system
objects.definition: A gas installation drawing family including supply point, meter or cylinder bank, regulators, pipework, isolation valves, appliance connections and flues where relevant.
functions: Keep combustion flues visible as physical objects

cad.pattern: Pipe network with equipment points and flue paths
cad.placement: External walls, roof spaces, plant rooms and appliance locations
cad.opening: Wall or roof penetrations for pipes and flues

notes: Do not use this ontology as gas design advice.

objects.name: gas meter and regulator set
objects.definition: A gas metering and pressure-control assembly at the gas supply point.
functions: Coordinate external wall or boundary location
Connect supply to internal gas pipework

cad.pattern: External equipment cluster with incoming and outgoing pipes
cad.placement: External wall, boundary or meter location
cad.opening: Wall penetration if pipe enters building

objects.name: gas pipe
objects.definition: A pipe carrying natural gas or LPG within a gas service system.
functions: Route gas between supply and appliances
Distinguish gas pipework from water and drainage

cad.pattern: Linear pipe route with valves and appliance branches
cad.placement: External, roof, ceiling, wall or floor service zones as documented
cad.opening: Wall or floor sleeves where penetrated

objects.name: gas isolation valve
objects.definition: A valve used to isolate a gas appliance, branch or section of gas pipework.

cad.pattern: Inline valve symbol or small 3D fitting on gas pipe
cad.placement: On gas pipe near appliances or branches

objects.name: gas appliance flue
objects.definition: A duct, pipe or terminal path that discharges combustion products from a gas appliance to outside air.
functions: Keep flues separate from ordinary exhaust ducts

cad.pattern: Linear flue route from appliance to terminal
cad.placement: From gas appliance through wall, ceiling or roof to outside

objects.name: LPG cylinder bank
objects.definition: A grouped external LPG cylinder installation with cylinders, restraints, regulator, valves and connection pipework.
functions: Connect cylinders to the gas service system

cad.pattern: Repeated vertical cylinders on pad with regulator set
cad.placement: External gas storage area

objects.name: curtain wall system
objects.definition: A non-loadbearing external wall system of mullions, transoms, glazing, panels, pressure plates, caps, seals, anchors and perimeter interfaces.
functions: Expose major curtain-wall parts for SketchUp tools

cad.pattern: Facade grid with vertical and horizontal framing members
cad.placement: External face of commercial building structure
cad.opening: Panel cells accept vision glass, doors or spandrels

notes: Use for modelling anatomy only. Engineering, wind, thermal, waterproofing and fire-stopping are separate evidence.

objects.name: curtain wall mullion
objects.definition: A vertical framing member in a curtain wall grid.
functions: Support or capture glazing and panels
Carry facade loads to anchors as designed

cad.pattern: Repeated vertical profiles
cad.placement: Within curtain wall facade grid

objects.name: curtain wall transom
objects.definition: A horizontal framing member in a curtain wall grid.
functions: Support or capture glazing and panels
Coordinate sill, head and stack-joint conditions

cad.pattern: Repeated horizontal profiles
cad.placement: Within curtain wall facade grid

objects.name: curtain wall pressure plate and cover cap
objects.definition: External capture hardware that clamps glazing or panels to curtain wall framing and covers the fixing line.
functions: Distinguish capped systems from structurally glazed joints

cad.pattern: Narrow external strips on mullions and transoms
cad.placement: Outside curtain wall glass or panel edges
cad.opening: Frames each glass or panel cell

objects.name: curtain wall spandrel panel
objects.definition: An opaque panel zone in a curtain wall, commonly used to conceal slab edges, structure or services.
functions: Separate vision glass from spandrel glass or panels

cad.pattern: Opaque panels within selected facade grid cells
cad.placement: At slab edges, plant zones or opaque facade areas
cad.opening: Occupies cell instead of clear vision glass

objects.name: curtain wall perimeter fire safing
objects.definition: A fire-resistant closure at the gap between a facade system and the edge of a floor or fire-rated construction.
functions: Keep fire-stopping visible in facade sections

cad.pattern: Continuous barrier line at slab edge behind facade
cad.placement: Between floor edge and curtain wall
cad.opening: Interrupted only where detailed firestop systems allow

objects.name: automatic sliding door assembly
objects.definition: An entrance door system with sliding leaves, head operator, sensors, tracks, side screens and control hardware.
functions: Coordinate opening width, sensors and head unit
Separate automatic doors from manual sliding doors

cad.pattern: Sliding door leaves under powered head track
cad.placement: Main entries and commercial openings

objects.name: revolving door assembly
objects.definition: A circular or polygonal entrance door system with rotating leaves inside a drum or enclosure.
functions: Show side screens and central shaft

cad.pattern: Circular entrance enclosure with rotating leaves
cad.placement: Main commercial entrances

objects.name: rapid roller door
objects.definition: A powered high-speed flexible or fabric roller door used for industrial, warehouse or specialist controlled openings.
functions: Coordinate side guides and head roll
Separate rapid doors from ordinary garage roller doors

cad.pattern: Vertical opening with head roll and side guides
cad.placement: Industrial or controlled-environment openings

objects.name: loading dock leveller
objects.definition: A hinged or telescopic platform installed at a loading dock to bridge between building floor and vehicle deck.
functions: Connect warehouse floor to truck loading zone

cad.pattern: Recessed platform at dock edge
cad.placement: At loading dock door opening

objects.name: access control hardware set
objects.definition: A coordinated door-security hardware set including reader, lock, controller, request-to-exit device, power and cabling interfaces.
functions: Keep lock, reader and controller as separable objects

cad.pattern: Door hardware points linked by cable routes
cad.placement: At controlled doors and nearby wall/ceiling spaces

objects.name: card reader
objects.definition: A wall, frame or mullion mounted credential reader used to request access through a controlled opening.
functions: Coordinate mounting height and cable route
Connect to a controlled door hardware set

cad.pattern: Small wall or mullion device near door
cad.placement: Entry side of controlled opening

objects.name: electric strike
objects.definition: An electrically controlled strike fitted to a door frame to release or secure a latch.
functions: Link access control to door latching

cad.pattern: Small hardware insert in door frame
cad.placement: Latch side of controlled door frame

objects.name: magnetic lock
objects.definition: An electromagnetic lock with a magnet and armature plate used to secure a controlled door.
functions: Connect to access control and egress devices

cad.pattern: Magnet on frame and plate on door leaf
cad.placement: Head or jamb of controlled door

objects.name: accessible path of travel
objects.definition: A continuous route made from floor surfaces, ramps, landings, doors, circulation spaces and access features that physically supports accessible movement.
functions: Group ramps, doors, landings and clearances

cad.pattern: Connected floor, ramp and opening sequence
cad.placement: Between accessible building entries, amenities and spaces

notes: This is a physical drawing grouping, not a rules engine.

objects.name: tactile ground surface indicator
objects.definition: A surface treatment with raised tactile features used to warn or direct pedestrians at specific locations.
functions: Show tactile warning or directional surface
Coordinate stair, ramp, platform and hazard interfaces
Distinguish tactile units from ordinary floor finish

cad.pattern: Array of raised dots or bars on walking surface
cad.placement: At stairs, ramps, crossings, platforms or decision points as documented

objects.name: installed grabrail
objects.definition: A fixed rail used for support in accessible sanitary, shower, change or circulation areas.
functions: Represent straight, angled, drop-down or wraparound rail shapes

cad.pattern: Tubular rail fixed to wall or floor
cad.placement: Beside WC, shower, bath, change table or accessible route as documented

objects.name: accessible sanitary fixture set
objects.definition: A coordinated accessible sanitary group including WC pan, basin, grabrails, circulation spaces, accessories and service connections.
functions: Coordinate pan, basin, rails and accessories

cad.pattern: Fixture group with rails and accessory positions
cad.placement: Accessible sanitary compartments and rooms

objects.name: accessible parking bay
objects.definition: A marked parking space with adjacent shared area, kerb ramp or access connection, wheel stops, bollards or signage where documented.
functions: Coordinate shared zone and access path
Represent physical markings and protection objects

cad.pattern: Painted bay and shared-zone markings with associated fixtures
cad.placement: Car park or site access area

objects.name: fixed access ladder
objects.definition: A fixed ladder, cage, gate or platform arrangement used to access roofs, plant, pits or service zones.
functions: Connect service areas across vertical height

cad.pattern: Vertical ladder with rungs and stiles
cad.placement: Walls, shafts, roofs or plant areas
cad.opening: Roof hatch or platform opening where present

objects.name: commercial kitchen exhaust hood
objects.definition: A canopy or exhaust hood over commercial cooking equipment, including filters, capture hood body, lights, fire service interfaces and duct connection.
functions: Coordinate cooking line, duct riser and ceiling space
Separate commercial hood from domestic rangehood

cad.pattern: Stainless canopy over cooking equipment with duct takeoff
cad.placement: Commercial kitchen cook line

objects.name: grease arrestor
objects.definition: A plumbing treatment unit that intercepts grease and solids from commercial kitchen wastewater before discharge.
functions: Coordinate floor, external or below-ground location

cad.pattern: Tank or chamber with inlet, outlet and access lids
cad.placement: Below floor, external yard or plant zone

objects.name: laboratory bench
objects.definition: A fixed specialist bench with worktop, under-bench storage, service outlets and chemical-resistant finishes.
functions: Separate laboratory joinery from ordinary kitchen joinery

cad.pattern: Bench run with service modules and storage
cad.placement: Laboratory rooms and teaching spaces

objects.name: fume cupboard
objects.definition: A ventilated laboratory enclosure with sash, work chamber, exhaust duct connection, services and base cabinet or support frame.

cad.pattern: Tall cabinet with sash and exhaust connection
cad.placement: Laboratory wall or island bench line

objects.name: cleanroom panel system
objects.definition: A controlled-environment room envelope made from cleanroom wall panels, ceiling panels, doors, glazing, coves, seals and service penetrations.
functions: Keep cleanroom parts separate from ordinary plasterboard partitions

cad.pattern: Sealed wall and ceiling panel envelope
cad.placement: Cleanroom, pharmacy, lab or production area as documented
cad.opening: Cleanroom doors, windows and service penetrations

objects.name: HEPA filter module
objects.definition: A ceiling or duct-mounted high-efficiency filter module serving a cleanroom or controlled environment.
functions: Coordinate ceiling grid and service access
Separate HEPA modules from ordinary diffusers

cad.pattern: Rectangular filter module in cleanroom ceiling
cad.placement: Ceiling grid or duct terminal

objects.name: standby generator set
objects.definition: A packaged engine-generator unit with enclosure, alternator, fuel system, exhaust, controls and connection to standby power equipment.
functions: Coordinate plinth, exhaust, ventilation and access
Connect generator to switchgear and fuel storage

cad.pattern: Large plant item on plinth with exhaust and cable interfaces
cad.placement: Plant room, external enclosure or roof plant area

objects.name: automatic transfer switch
objects.definition: Electrical switching equipment that transfers load between normal supply and standby generator supply.
functions: Coordinate wall or floor mounted cabinet

cad.pattern: Electrical cabinet near generator or switchboard
cad.placement: Electrical room or plant area

objects.name: lightning protection system
objects.definition: A protection system made from air terminals, roof conductors, down conductors, bonds and earth terminations.
functions: Connect roof protection to earth termination

cad.pattern: Roof and wall conductor network with terminals and earth points
cad.placement: Roof edges, ridges, plant and external walls
cad.opening: Penetrations where conductors pass through construction

objects.name: lightning air terminal
objects.definition: A rod or terminal installed at a roof, mast or exposed point as part of a lightning protection system.
functions: Connect to roof or down conductors

cad.pattern: Vertical rod on roof or mast
cad.placement: High points, roof edges, plant or nominated protection points

objects.name: lightning down conductor
objects.definition: A conductor route carrying lightning protection continuity from roof-level conductors down to earth termination.
functions: Coordinate facade fixings and test links

cad.pattern: Vertical conductor fixed to facade or structure
cad.placement: External walls, shafts or protected routes

objects.name: retaining wall system
objects.definition: A site wall system retaining soil, including wall elements, footing or embedment, drainage, backfill, geogrid or posts where applicable.
functions: Expose wall family parts for SketchUp site tools

cad.pattern: Wall line with retained soil side and drainage zone
cad.placement: Site level changes and excavations
cad.opening: Drain outlets and steps where documented

notes: Engineering design is outside the ontology.

objects.name: segmental block retaining wall
objects.definition: A retaining wall made from interlocking concrete or masonry blocks, commonly with drainage aggregate and optional geogrid reinforcement.

cad.pattern: Stacked block courses following retaining wall line
cad.placement: At site level changes
cad.load: Retaining wall facing and structure as designed

objects.name: post and panel retaining wall
objects.definition: A retaining wall made from vertical posts and horizontal panels or sleepers spanning between posts.
functions: Coordinate post spacing and panel stack

cad.pattern: Repeated vertical posts with stacked panels between
cad.placement: At site level changes

objects.name: geogrid reinforcement
objects.definition: A geosynthetic reinforcement layer placed in retained soil behind selected retaining wall systems.
functions: Connect wall facing to retained soil zone

cad.pattern: Horizontal mesh layers extending behind wall
cad.placement: In compacted backfill behind retaining wall

objects.name: agricultural drain behind retaining wall
objects.definition: A perforated drainage pipe and aggregate zone used to relieve water behind a retaining wall or site structure.
functions: Separate subsoil drains from stormwater roof drains

cad.pattern: Perforated pipe at base of drainage aggregate
cad.placement: Behind retaining wall at base or drainage layer

objects.name: stormwater detention outlet control
objects.definition: An orifice, weir, plate, valve or outlet assembly that controls discharge from an on-site stormwater detention volume.
functions: Separate outlet control from ordinary pipework

cad.pattern: Outlet fitting or plate inside detention pit or tank
cad.placement: At detention tank, basin or control pit outlet

objects.name: gross pollutant trap
objects.definition: A stormwater treatment device that captures litter, coarse sediment or gross pollutants before discharge.
functions: Coordinate pit, inlet, outlet and access covers

cad.pattern: Treatment chamber with inlet, outlet and access covers
cad.placement: Stormwater line before discharge or reuse

objects.name: trench grate drain
objects.definition: A linear surface drainage channel with removable grate, channel body, outlets and end caps.
functions: Collect surface water along a line
Coordinate driveway, threshold and paved-area drainage
Expose grate and channel as separate drawable parts

cad.pattern: Long narrow channel with top grate
cad.placement: Driveways, paths, thresholds, courtyards and paved areas
